description: This Java class 'EntityDataServices' provides services for importing, exporting, and managing entity data, including file-based import/export, index rebuilding, and encryption key re-encryption within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityDataServices
classes.description: Provides data import/export, index management, and encryption key re-encryption services for entity data within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: exportDelimitedToDirectory
methods.description: Stub method indicating export functionality is not yet implemented.

methods.name: importDelimitedFromDirectory
methods.description: Imports entity data files from a specified directory, processing each file to update the database.

methods.name: importDelimitedFile
methods.description: Imports data from a specific delimited file into the database.

methods.name: getFileList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of data files from the root directory, either from FILELIST.txt or by directory scan.

methods.name: readEntityHeader
methods.description: Reads the header (field names) from a data file or its associated header file.

methods.name: readEntityFile
methods.description: Reads and processes a data file, creating or updating entity records in the database.

methods.name: makeGenericValue
methods.description: Constructs a GenericValue object from header and line data for database insertion.

methods.name: rebuildAllIndexesAndKeys
methods.description: Rebuilds database indexes, primary keys, and foreign keys for a specified entity group, optionally fixing column sizes.

methods.name: unwrapByteWrappers
methods.description: Unwraps byte wrapper fields in entity records, storing the raw bytes.

methods.name: reencryptPrivateKeys
methods.description: Re-encrypts private keys stored in the EntityKeyStore, optionally using old and new encryption keys.

methods.name: reencryptFields
methods.description: Re-encrypts encrypted fields in entities within a specified group.
